name: Claude Cream + Coral
lineage: v1 — original one-shot; root of all later versions
signature: Floating terminal windows in the hero with a drifting hand-indicator blob
description: Original one-shot: warm dark cream ground with coral accents, floating terminal-window hero and a drifting hand-indicator blob.

name: Studio Projector
lineage: v2 — iteration on v1; adds theme selector (accent-only) and projector hero
signature: Person silhouette in front of a projected wall of 6 agent cards with a light beam
description: Matte playful primary palette with an accent-only theme selector (6 palettes) and a new hero: a person silhouetted before a projected wall of six agent cards with live todo list and beam.

name: Full-Site Themes
lineage: v3 — iteration on v2; projector scene locked dark, themes now restyle the whole site
signature: Eight full-site palettes (Studio, Playground, Forest, Citrus, Ocean, Rose, Graphite, Midnight)
description: Projector hero locked to its best dark look; the theme selector now restyles the entire site (neutrals + accents) with 8 palettes and scenario 4 goes gesture-first.

name: Forest Fonts

fonts.display: Fraunces (+7-option title-font selector: Instrument Serif, Playfair, DM Serif, Cormorant, Space Grotesk, Inter Tight)

lineage: v4 — branches from v3; superseded by v5 (which branched back from v3)
signature: Title-font selector chips each previewing their own typeface
description: Forest made default with a 7-face title-font selector and a richer two-people-with-shared-screen SVG scene — rejected because the picker logic broke the hero projector scene, so v5 branched from v3 instead.

name: Title Alternation

fonts.display: Fraunces italic (rotating hero words in Pacifico, Cabin Sketch, Exo 2 italic, Viga)

lineage: v5 — branches from v3 (v4 skipped); base of v6-v8 line
signature: Three hero words gently rotating through 5 typefaces with zero layout shift
description: Pickers removed and Forest palette locked; three hero title words rotate through 5 faces (Fraunces italic, Pacifico, Cabin Sketch, Exo 2, Viga) and scenario 4 gets a heavily upgraded SVG scene with waving, nodding figures and sequenced speech bubbles.

name: Fraunces Only (Muted Interest)
lineage: v6 — successor of v5; removes the title-font alternation
description: Title alternation stripped back to Fraunces-only and the interest section muted (cream text stepped down to 76%/88%/62% mixes, softened glows, pulled-back ticker border).

name: Phone, SEO & Logo
lineage: v7 — iteration on v6; introduces logo-options.html (13 lockup variations), carried by v8-v16
signature: Enlarged logo hand (viewBox 80→48) filling ~85% of the mark
description: Phone-control card overlap fixed and 'gesture-based terminal multiplexer' added everywhere for SEO (meta, OG, JSON-LD); logo hand enlarged and a logo-options.html gallery of 13 lockup variations introduced (inherited by v8-v16).

name: Mobile Gesture Form
lineage: v8 — iteration on v7; adopts the 'Logo G' wordmark and ports the real gesture engine
signature: Full-page camera gesture overlay with corner widget (smoothing/sensitivity sliders)
description: Logo G adopted in the nav; the real qalarc.com gesture engine is ported (full-page overlay, palm-normalised pinch, lerp-smoothed scroll) plus a mobile pass that promotes the Phone-control card and swaps the notify form to a Google Form POST.

name: Gesture Fixed
lineage: v9 — fixes v8's jittery gesture widget and post-disable scroll persistence
signature: One-Euro-filtered pinch scrolling with a '✕ stop' full-teardown button
description: Gesture widget jitter and scroll persistence fixed with a One-Euro filter on dY, bigger dead-zone, calmer defaults, and a '✕ stop' button that fully tears down camera, RAFs and state.

name: Gesture Playground
lineage: v10 — abandons v9's scroll-hijack for a fullscreen playground
signature: Pinch spawns glowing energy orbs; mycelium filaments grow toward them
description: Scroll-hijack abandoned for a fullscreen gesture playground: mycelium filaments and twinkling tips behind the page, both hands tracked with gesture-label pills (PINCH, OPEN PALM, FIST…), and pinches spawning glowing orbs the mycelium grows toward.

name: Organic Mycelium
lineage: v11 — fixes v10's render-loop bug; superseded by v12
signature: BFS-grown mycelium networks with signal pulses and drifting spores under multiply blend
description: Hands finally render (v10's gmxActive ordering bug) with BFS-grown demo-organic.doof.ing-style mycelium promoted over the whole site via multiply blending — rejected as too dark and too laggy.

name: Snappy Point Cloud
lineage: v12 — replaces v11's mycelium with a performant point cloud
signature: ~70 drifting glow points connected by proximity lines that chase fingertips
description: Mycelium replaced by ~70 glowing points in additive light/glow blending (bright honey / sage / cream / coral) that visibly chase fingertips with 200px pull and glow lines, O(N) per frame at 30/60fps caps.

name: Zoom Launcher
lineage: v13 — hardening iteration (basis for v15; its zoom slider fixed in v14, then dropped)
signature: Pinch-drag flick launcher throwing momentum orbs; escalating crash watchdog
description: Crash recovery rebuilt with a 1.2s per-frame timeout and escalating watchdog (kick → recreate Hands → full teardown), art revealed only on enable, a camera zoom slider, and a pinch-drag launcher that flicks orbs with release momentum.

name: Amplify (Overscan)
lineage: v14 — branches from v13; rejected, so v15 branched from v13 instead
signature: Hand-overlay canvas extending 18vmin past every viewport edge
description: Overscan amplification maps the camera's full range onto a canvas extended 18vmin past the viewport so small hand moves cover the screen — rejected: it crashed and rendered hands off-screen.

name: Auto Restart
lineage: v15 — branched from v13 (v14 rejected); base of v16
signature: Full MediaPipe pipeline restart with visible 'restarting…' state
description: Fixes the chronic disappearing-hands bug with a full pipeline restart (stop stream, close Hands, 400ms wait, re-init) that detects both freeze (no results for 3s) and blind (no landmarks for 12s) failure modes.

name: Wide Canvas
lineage: v16 — latest version, iteration on v15
signature: 12vw overscan hand overlay plus vote counter gated at 200 real votes
description: Hand overlay extends 12vw past each viewport edge on desktop; the vote counter stays hidden until 200 real votes, hardware/OS details are captured per vote with a visible privacy disclosure, and the enable button moves into the try section.
